text:
Riya (People Ops): Hey folks 1 1 1 1  
I'm prototyping a tiny 'promotion readiness cheatsheet' for IC->SrIC, IC->Manager and cross-lane moves. Aim: a checklist managers can paste into review threads so promotion discussions are tidy and evidence-focused. Quick eyes please.

Riya (People Ops): High-level constraints: 6 bullets max per checklist, one-line evidence examples, one manager calibration question, and a Hiring Ops trigger.

Omar (Eng): Love it. Can we make a simple 'must-have' vs 'nice-to-have' split so managers know if it's borderline vs clear?

Riya (People Ops): Yup 1 split into MUST / NICE. Draft below (copy-pasteable).

Riya (People Ops): Promotion readiness cheatsheet (paste into review threads):
```
Role move: IC -> Senior IC (MUST)
- Demonstrated measurable impact (metric or eval) across at least one product area
- Owned a cross-team project or technical design with clear outcome
- Reliable delivery and post-rollout attention (incidents <=1 in 90d)
(NICE)
- Mentored >=2 engineers & contributed to hiring loop
- Presented at an internal tech review or shared learning doc
- Clear evidence artifacts: PRs, dash links, eval IDs, rollout notes
Manager calibration Q: "Would this person sustainably grow others' output vs only deliver individual impact?"
Hiring Ops trigger: if promoted, file Hiring Ops change request within 7 days (link)

Role move: IC -> Engineering Manager (MUST)
- Has coached peers with repeatable examples and outcomes
- Demonstrated stakeholder work (roadmaps, prioritization) for a team-sized scope
- Ran at least one cross-functional initiative end-to-end with metrics or stakeholder sign-off
(NICE)
- Directly led hiring interviews or onboarding improvements
- Provided one clear team growth plan and ramp expectation
- Evidence artifacts: 1-2 peer quotes, roadmap doc, retro notes
Manager calibration Q: "Do we see durable coaching behaviors and clear delegation vs doing the work?"

Role move: IC -> Cross-lane (IC -> Platform lead / IC->PM-adjacent) (MUST)
- Demonstrated domain depth + collaboration: shipped changes that enabled other teams
- Owned a cross-team SLA, runbook, or infra contract with measurable effect
- Clear transition plan showing handoffs and knowledge transfer
(NICE)
- Created technical standards or shared libraries adopted by 2+ teams
- Wrote onboarding material or played recurring ops/oncall role
- Evidence artifacts: contract doc, adoption stats, runbook links
Manager calibration Q: "Is the person likely to scale their current impact when pulled away from day-to-day tasks?"
```

Selene (Eng Manager): This is super usable. Two micro-edits: require at least one dashboard link or eval id in MUST evidence; and for manager moves, prefer 2 peer quotes if available.

Riya (People Ops): Will make those edits: add 'dashboard link or eval id' to the MUST evidence and note '2 peer quotes preferred' for manager moves.

Vik (Director): Add a short 'what to include when you file the promotion packet' checklist please: 1-sentence pitch, 3 evidence bullets, manager recommendation, calibration notes. Makes Hiring Ops intake clean.

Riya (People Ops): Good call. Adding a compact promotion packet footer: "Packet: 1-line promo rationale; 3 evidence bullets (with links); peer quotes (if any); manager rec + calibration note."

hr-bot: Draft posted: https://handbook.redwood.company/people-ops/promotion-cheatsheet (internal)

Omar (Eng): LGTM. I'll pilot this with my ICs and give feedback on borderline cases.

Riya (People Ops): Thanks everyone 1 planning to push the final version tomorrow AM. If you want wording changes, drop them here before EOD."
